text: Enterprise Order Approval and Processing Policy
text_for_ai: Introduction: Enterprise Order Approval and Processing Policy

text: This policy outlines the procedures and approval hierarchy for processing sales orders within the ERP system.
text_for_ai: 1. Purpose: This policy outlines the procedures and approval hierarchy for processing sales orders within the ERP system.

text: Applies to all orders created through the ERP system, including online and offline transactions.
text_for_ai: 2. Scope: Applies to all orders created through the ERP system, including online and offline transactions.

text: Orders are categorized as: • Standard Orders (≤ USD 1000) • High-Value Orders (> USD 1000) • Bulk Orders (> 50 items) • International Orders
text_for_ai: 3. Order Classification: Orders are categorized as: • Standard Orders (≤ USD 1000) • High-Value Orders (> USD 1000) • Bulk Orders (> 50 items) • International Orders

text: • Bulk orders must be validated by the Sales Department • International orders require compliance verification • Orders missing customer or billing data are automatically rejected
text_for_ai: 5. Special Conditions: • Bulk orders must be validated by the Sales Department • International orders require compliance verification • Orders missing customer or billing data are automatically rejected

text: Each order must: • Be assigned a unique Sales Order ID • Be linked to a Customer ID • Maintain traceability across: o Order creation o Approval stages o Shipment and billing
text_for_ai: 6. ERP Workflow Integration: Each order must: • Be assigned a unique Sales Order ID • Be linked to a Customer ID • Maintain traceability across: o Order creation o Approval stages o Shipment and billing

text: • Fraud detection checks for high-value orders • Duplicate order detection • Credit validation for customers
text_for_ai: 7. Risk Control Measures: • Fraud detection checks for high-value orders • Duplicate order detection • Credit validation for customers

text: • Order validation: same day • Approval cycle: 1–2 days • Fulfillment: 2–5 business days
text_for_ai: 8. Processing Timeline: • Order validation: same day • Approval cycle: 1–2 days • Fulfillment: 2–5 business days

text: All order transactions are: • Logged in ERP system • Tracked for anomalies • Available for audit and reporting
text_for_ai: 9. Audit and Monitoring: All order transactions are: • Logged in ERP system • Tracked for anomalies • Available for audit and reporting

text: Enterprise Sales Refund and Return Policy
text_for_ai: Introduction: Enterprise Sales Refund and Return Policy

text: This policy defines the rules, conditions, and procedures governing refund and return requests for products sold through the organization's ERP-managed sales system.
text_for_ai: 1. Purpose: This policy defines the rules, conditions, and procedures governing refund and return requests for products sold through the organization's ERP-managed sales system.

text: This policy applies to all customers, sales representatives, and finance personnel involved in order processing, delivery, and refund management.
text_for_ai: 2. Scope: This policy applies to all customers, sales representatives, and finance personnel involved in order processing, delivery, and refund management.

section_title: 3.1 Refund requests must be submitted within 30 calendar days from the order delivery
text_for_ai: 3.1 Refund requests must be submitted within 30 calendar days from the order delivery: date.

text: • Products marked as “Final Sale” are not eligible for refund. • Refunds will not be processed for damages caused by misuse or negligence. • Digital products and services are non-refundable.
text_for_ai: 5. Exceptions: • Products marked as “Final Sale” are not eligible for refund. • Refunds will not be processed for damages caused by misuse or negligence. • Digital products and services are non-refundable.

text: • Refund validation: 2 business days • Approval cycle: 1–3 business days • Payment processing: 5–7 business days
text_for_ai: 6. Processing Timeline: • Refund validation: 2 business days • Approval cycle: 1–3 business days • Payment processing: 5–7 business days

text: All refund requests must be: • Logged in the ERP system • Linked to the corresponding Sales Order ID • Associated with customer profile data
text_for_ai: 7. ERP System Integration: All refund requests must be: • Logged in the ERP system • Linked to the corresponding Sales Order ID • Associated with customer profile data

text: All refund transactions are: • Logged for audit trails • Subject to compliance review • Stored for a minimum of 5 years
text_for_ai: 8. Audit and Compliance: All refund transactions are: • Logged for audit trails • Subject to compliance review • Stored for a minimum of 5 years
